📖 How to use

  1. Enter the first day of your last menstrual period.
  2. Press Calculate.
  3. See your estimated due date (LMP + 280 days).
  4. Check your current week and trimester.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the due date calculated?

Add 280 days (40 weeks) to the first day of the last menstrual period — this is Naegele's rule.

How accurate is the due date?

Only about 4–5% of babies arrive exactly on the due date; most come within two weeks either side.

What are the trimesters?

Weeks 1–13 are the first trimester, 14–27 the second, and 28–40 the third.
